_doc: A form is a REPERTOIRE of vantages (camera positions its grammar can cut between). Top-level queries/accept = the FORM-FIRST path (static, prompt-agnostic). vantages[] = the per-vantage priors the PROMPT-FIRST manifest brain selects from. shot_grammar: single = one relaxed shot; multi = the form cuts across vantages.
